downtown.name: Downtown
downtown.description: Busy offices and nightlife. Huge foot traffic, wealthy customers, brutal rent.

oldtown.name: Old Town
oldtown.description: Charming streets full of tourists and collectors. Good traffic, fair rent.

suburbs.name: Suburbs
suburbs.description: Quiet family homes. Modest traffic and budgets, cheap rent. A good place to start.

industrial.name: Industrial Park
industrial.description: Warehouses and workers on a budget. Low traffic, the cheapest and largest lots.

beach.name: Beachfront
beach.description: Tourists with money to burn, mostly by day. Great for leisure businesses.
